1 (Currently amended): A loading ramp, said loading ramp comprising: a support structure having a mounting member, said mounting member being compatible with a truck having a bed such that said support structure is adapted to be removably mounted to the truck; a first gradient member secured to said support structure, said first gradient member defining a first surface, a proximate end, and a distal end, the proximate end being opposite the distal end with respect to the first surface, the proximate end being proximate the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, the first surface being structured to support a small vehicle, wherein said first gradient member is distinct from any second gradient member.

2 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said loading ramp makes available storage space provided by the truck otherwise occupied when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck, and wherein said loading ramp is capable of being carried by the truck without obstructing access to the truck bed.

3 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 2 wherein said loading ramp supports at least a portion of the small vehicle when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck, and wherein said loading ramp is configured to maintain stability during transport.

4 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said mounting member is compatible with a receiver-type hitch, and wherein said mounting member is adapted to securely attach to the truck.

5 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said support structure is adjustable such that the proximate end of said first gradient member is proximate the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck regardless of the size of the truck, and wherein said adjustment mechanism is user-friendly.

6 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the proximate end of said first gradient member rests against a rear bumper of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, and wherein said first gradient member is designed to accommodate various bumper heights.

7 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the proximate end of said first gradient member rests against the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, and wherein said first gradient member is structured to prevent slippage during use.

9 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the first surface defined by said first gradient member includes a solid surface, and wherein said solid surface is constructed from a material that provides traction for the small vehicle.

12 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the second surface defined by said second gradient member includes a solid surface, and wherein said solid surface is constructed from a material that provides traction for the small vehicle.

19 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a mechanical device, said mechanical device moving said second gradient member between the up position and down position, and wherein said mechanical device is operable by a single user.

20 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a locking member, said locking member locking said second gradient member at the up position, and wherein said locking member is designed for easy engagement and disengagement.

23 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 20 wherein said locking member includes a mechanical device that provides a visual indication of the locked position.

24 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the truck is selected from the group consisting of a pickup truck, a sports utility vehicle, and a van.

25 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the small vehicle is selected from the group consisting of a lawnmower, an ATV, a snowmobile, and a motorcycle. 

30 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 26 wherein the truck is selected from the group consisting of a pickup truck, a sports utility vehicle, and a van.
